registration_statements: The cardiac autonomic control was evaluated by 10 min recordings at supine rest between 0800 and 0900 hours. During this test period, interbeat intervals of cardiac function were registered continuously by the electrocardiogram (ECG, WinAcq, Absolute Aliens, Finland) and the peripheral blood pressure was monitored by photopletysmographic method (Portapres, Finapres Medical Systems, The Netherlands). The circulatory parameters were calculated with special software of neurocardiological analyses (WinCPRS, Absolute Aliens, Finland) [ 44 , 45 ].
